title: Close the V4 P1 module registry and authority gate
goal: Add a strict hash-bound module registry and enforce an independent maximum capability grant for every installed module.
acceptanceCriteria: The module registry schema is strict and hash-bound by the contracts manifest.
Every installed module has exactly one registry entry binding its ID, manifest path/hash and allowed capabilities.
Unknown registry fields, duplicate IDs, path escape, manifest drift and undisclosed module directories fail closed.
A module cannot self-grant an unregistered root, process, network capability or timeout.
The empty package and all prior P0/P1A tests remain green.
Current V3 validation remains green with no active workflow or remote change.
